record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: For a vertex operator algebra V of central charge 24 such that every irreducible V-module is equivalent to V and every V-module is completely reducible, is V determined uniquely by the Lie algebra structure on its homogeneous subspace of weight one?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 7.1. Let V be a vertex operator algebra satisfying the following three conditions: (1) The central charge of V is 24.

Conjecture 7.2. Let V be a vertex operator algebra satisfying the first and the third conditions in Conjecture 7.1. Then V is determined uniquely by the Lie algebra structure on its homogeneous subspace of weight 1.

artifact.status_search_result: A combined effort by many authors over roughly three decades has shown that each of the 71 Lie algebras on Schellekens' list is realized by a strongly rational, holomorphic vertex operator algebra of central charge 24, and that—except in the case where the weight-one space is zero (the Moonshine module case, which remains the famous open Frenkel–Lepowsky–Meurman uniqueness conjecture)—the VOA is uniquely determined by its weight-one Lie algebra. Recent works (van Ekeren–Möller–Scheithauer, Lam–Shimakura, Höhn, and others, ca. 2018–2022) completed the uniqueness proofs for all nonzero weight-one cases.

status_evidence.title: Schellekens' List and the Very Strange Formula
status_evidence.snippet: Each potential Lie algebra on Schellekens' list is realised by a strongly rational, holomorphic vertex operator algebra of central charge 24 and this vertex operator algebra is uniquely determined by its weight one structure if the weight one subspace is nonzero.
status_evidence.claim: Uniqueness given nonzero weight-one Lie algebra is established.

status_evidence.title: Automorphism Groups and Uniqueness of Holomorphic VOAs of Central Charge 24
status_evidence.snippet: Uniqueness of holomorphic vertex operator algebras of central charge 24.

status_evidence.title: Inertia Groups and Uniqueness of Holomorphic Vertex Operator Algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Uniqueness of holomorphic VOAs at central charge 24 via inertia group methods.
